summary: Steel fire tower erected at Green Lake in the Meadow Lake District in 1950, per a DNR annual report; no height, staffing or later history found.

events.note: A new steel tower was erected at Green Lake; the source does not say whether an earlier tower stood there

evidence.supports: New steel tower erected at Green Lake in the Meadow Lake District in 1950
evidence.quote: 1950: A new steel tower was erected at Green Lake in the Meadow Lake District

evidence.supports: The 1950 entry cites the DNR annual report for 1950-51
evidence.quote: Department of Natural resources Annual report, 1950-51

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only two pages say anything about this tower. The Canada's Fire Lookouts entry is one line, citing a DNR annual report that was not seen directly. The Firetowers of Saskatchewan listing gives coordinates only; its height and construction-year fields are blank, and its notes field shows a bare '1970' that the page does not explain (not used). Two WebSearch queries found no other Green Lake tower source. Staffing, fate and present condition are unknown, so the story is short. Status is left unknown. The brief's agency (Saskatchewan Public Safety Agency) is not named in any source read; the source names the DNR. No photos added.
